page.overview:
What is Hiso Hiso no Mi?

The Hiso Hiso no Mi is an anime-only Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to understand the heart of an animal; in other words, it allows them to "speak" telepathically to animals. It was eaten by Apis.

The power of the fruit was first demonstrated but not clearly explained when the Marines under Nelson discovered that Apis was aboard the Going Merry and began attacking the ship. The Devil Fruit's ability was shown when Apis learned from the seagulls that a strong wind was coming their way, which allowed the crew and her to escape from the pursuing Marines.

The fruit's power enables the user to telepathically communicate with animals, and it was indicated that this even enables her to understand Sea Kings, as one instance had her notice their underwater presence before any of the Straw Hats.

No weaknesses are currently known aside from the standard Devil Fruits drawbacks.
